sources.supports: xAI's current pricing documentation lists the model's long-context rates as $2.50 input, $0.40 cached input, and $5.00 output per million tokens. It does not establish the prior rate or when this rate became effective.

notes: The available first-party xAI page confirms the current long-context rates but does not state their effective date or the preceding rates. The Internet Archive CDX endpoint timed out when queried for May 2026 snapshots, so no archived before/after evidence was available to decide whether the earlier models.dev rate was official or an error.
